text: dsh-infinite-canvas（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：让 DSH 通过后端 API 管理已保存的 Infinite Canvas 画布。它向 DSH 注册画布、节点、目录和媒体任务工具，并提供设置面板与可选网页 Agent 启动器。主要功能包括列出和新建画布、查询及编辑节点和连线、分组与自动排布，以及提交和同步图像、音频或视频任务。适合在 DSH 中整理画布内容、制作故事板或管理媒体生成。使用前需要 Infinite Canvas 站点地址和有相应权限的用户 API Key；可选 Agent 供网页端助手使用。

dsh-infinite-canvas lets DSH manage saved canvases: create projects, edit nodes and layouts, and manage media tasks. It adds a settings panel and optional web Agent launcher. Requires a canvas site and scoped user API Key.
我想直接在 DSH 里查看和管理保存的无限画布。
能不能让 DSH 帮我查询画布里的节点和上下游关系？
我需要在画布中创建文本、图像或视频节点并连线。
帮我把画布节点分组，再自动整理它们的位置。
我想在 DSH 里发起媒体生成任务并查看结果状态。
Can DSH edit my saved canvas without opening the browser?
I need to organize nodes and connections in a canvas from my assistant.
How can I check the status of an image or video generation task?
dsh-infinite-canvas 的功能「画布节点编辑」：在指定画布中创建和更新文本、图片、音频或视频节点，维护节点之间的连接，也可移动、删除、分组和排布节点。通过节点工具的操作参数触发，写入前需提交最新版本号。
dsh-infinite-canvas 的功能「媒体任务管理」：为画布媒体节点提交图像、音频或视频任务，随后查询状态并将主要结果地址和媒体元数据同步回节点。通过媒体工具触发，需提供模型、渠道及符合后端接口的请求对象。
dsh-infinite-canvas 的功能「画布项目管理」：列出、创建、重命名或删除已保存画布，并可返回查看链接。通过项目工具选择操作和画布 ID 触发；创建结果会回读确认，修改和删除需使用当前版本信息。
dsh-infinite-canvas 的功能「目录查询」：读取后端公开模型和渠道选项、已保存工作流、个人或系统技能，也能获取系统技能文件。通过目录工具指定资源类型以及技能文件路径触发，返回对应的后端数据。
dsh-infinite-canvas 使用前须知：后端操作需配置用户 API Key，媒体生成可能消耗额度。版本检查无法消除网页与 API 并发编辑冲突（见 canvas-operations.js:149-159）。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · dsh-infinite-canvas：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Operate saved [Infinite Canvas](https://github.com/TNTest/infinite-canvas) projects directly from DeepSeek Harness through a user API Key. An independent optional launcher starts the local Agent for the canvas web app.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Quick start：1. Install the plugin bundle from `https://github.com/TNTest/dsh-infinite-canvas`.
2. Open **Settings → Infinite Canvas**. The default deployment is `https://infic.transiglobal.com`.
3. Create a dedicated `ic_` user Key in the canvas site's **Account → API Key**, paste it into the plugin, then choose **Verify & save**. Reading needs `read`; canvas edits need `read + write`; generation needs `generate`; deleting resources needs `delete`.
4. Ask Harness to list, create or edit a canvas. Backend tools work with the browser closed and the local Agent stopped. The bundled `infinite-canvas` skill is registered automatically.
5. **View canvases** is optional. If the page is already open, save its edits before API operations and reload it afterwards to see saved changes.
dsh-infinite-canvas README · Quick start：No browser-console login token is needed. API authentication does not sign the browser into the website.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Two independent paths：| Path | Purpose | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Backend API tools | Saved canvases, nodes, connections, groups, layout and backend media tasks | Deployment URL and API Key |
| Optional web-Agent launcher | Start/stop the local Agent used by the assistant in the canvas web app | Node.js 22+, `npx`, and an open canvas page when using that assistant |

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Two independent paths：The launcher retains automatic startup, a configurable local address and **Open web app with Agent**. Its default command is `npx -y @tigerowo/canvas-agent@latest`; the first start may download dependencies. The Agent's connection token is read automatically and used only for an explicitly requested web handshake. It is independent of the user API Key.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Two independent paths：Creating or editing a canvas never opens or switches browser tabs. The plugin no longer uses a stdio MCP bridge for backend editing. The old `infinite-canvas-mcp` row ships disabled for upgrades; disable any old profile override that explicitly enables it. The web Agent does not need that Harness MCP row.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Agent tools：| Tool | Actions |
| --- | --- |
| `infinite_canvas_status` | Check backend connectivity independently from the optional launcher |
| `infinite_canvas_projects` | `list`, `create`, `rename`, `delete`; `open` only returns a plain viewing URL |
| `infinite_canvas_nodes` | `summary`, `query`, `get`, `upstream`, `downstream`, `connected`; `create_text`, `create_primary_script`, `create_media`, `update_text`, `rename`, `move`, `delete`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `group`, `arrange` |
| `infinite_canvas_catalog` | Public models/channels, saved workflows, personal/system skills and system skill files |
| `infinite_canvas_media` | `submit`, read-only `status`, `sync` result into a node, `stop` a backend task |

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Agent tools：Every node/media call names a `canvasId`. Reads return `project.revision`; node edits, project rename/delete and media submit/sync require a fresh `expectedRevision`. Writes preserve unrelated project fields and read back the result. Writes from this plugin are serialized per canvas, and known stale revisions are rejected. **The current backend has no atomic compare-and-swap**, so simultaneous browser/API editing can still race; do not treat these checks as collaborative real-time synchronization.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Agent tools：Node deletion cleans graph edges, group/batch membership and stale chat media references, but retains actual files, backend tasks and generation history. Grouping does not support nested groups or batch nodes; individual batch movement and batch layout remain web-app functions. There is no API equivalent of a mouse selection, unsaved browser state, local Codex session or private browser model configuration.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Backend media tasks：Prepare an image, video or audio node with `create_media`; this never starts generation. `submit` needs an explicit backend `channelId` and a `request` JSON object containing `model` and the provider's required parameters. The Key is never placed in that object. Image-edit JSON requests can use `edit: true` with explicitly supplied references.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Backend media tasks：`status` only reads the task; `sync` writes its current status and primary result URL/media metadata into the node. Additional result URLs remain in the task response; sync does not recreate the web app's batch-result UI. Workflows can be discovered, but workflow execution, multipart uploads, browser-local providers and arbitrary model-specific parameter translation are not implemented by this tool.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Backend media tasks：Generation requires the user's authorization and can consume credits. Submission IDs are saved before sending the request; submitted nodes cannot be submitted again. On an uncertain timeout, query the retained task ID rather than retrying. Stop requests are not deletion or guaranteed refunds. Permissions, provider payloads and availability still apply even when the canvas itself is editable.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Credentials and local files：- UI settings: `$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/settings.json`.
- API Key: `$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/canvas-api.json`, mode `0600`, bound to its verified deployment URL. `CANVAS_API_KEY` can override it for the deployment in the plugin row configuration.
- Optional web-Agent token: `~/.infinite-canvas/codex-agent.json`; redacted launcher log: `$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/agent.log`.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Credentials and local files：The Key is sent only in the `Authorization` header, never in links or tool output. Remote deployments require HTTPS; localhost HTTP is allowed for testing. Authenticated requests do not follow redirects. Changing the deployment makes its old saved Key unavailable until a Key is verified for the new URL.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · Verification：```bash
node test/canvas.test.mjs
node test/host.test.mjs
node test/client.test.mjs
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts

Tests cover graph edits and preservation, revision conflicts, group movement, media submission/recovery/sync with fake tasks, HTTP credential isolation, backend edits with the web Agent stopped, optional Agent start/stop and settings rendering without automatic browser navigation. Real paid generation needs separate authorized acceptance for the selected model/channel.

dsh-infinite-canvas README · dsh-infinite-canvas：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

通过用户 API Key，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作后端已保存的 [Infinite Canvas](https://github.com/TNTest/infinite-canvas) 画布。另保留独立、可选的本地 Agent 启动器，供画布网页使用。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 快速开始：1. 通过 `https://github.com/TNTest/dsh-infinite-canvas` 安装插件包。
2. 打开「设置 → 无限画布」，默认站点为 `https://infic.transiglobal.com`。
3. 在画布站「账户 → API Key」创建专用的 `ic_` 用户 Key，粘贴到插件后点击「验证并保存」。读取需要 `read`，编辑画布需要 `read + write`，生成需要 `generate`，删除资源需要 `delete`。
4. 让 Harness 列出、新建或编辑画布。浏览器关闭、本地 Agent 停止时，后端工具仍然可用；插件自动注册内置的 `infinite-canvas` skill。
5. 「查看画布」是可选入口。网页已经打开时，请先保存网页改动，再执行 API 操作，完成后刷新网页查看结果。

无需在浏览器控制台获取登录 Token。API 鉴权也不会代替浏览器登录网站。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 两条独立链路：| 链路 | 用途 | 依赖 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 后端 API 工具 | 已保存画布、节点、连线、分组、布局和后端媒体任务 | 站点地址和 API Key |
| 可选网页 Agent 启动器 | 一键启停画布网页右侧智能体使用的本地 Agent | Node.js 22+、`npx`；使用网页智能体时需打开画布页面 |

启动器保留随 Harness 启动、可配置的本地地址，以及「打开网页并连接 Agent」。默认命令为 `npx -y @tigerowo/canvas-agent@latest`，首次启动可能需要下载依赖。插件自动读取 Agent 连接令牌，仅在明确打开网页并连接时用于握手；它与用户 API Key 相互独立。

新建、编辑画布不会打开或切换浏览器标签页。后端编辑不再依赖 stdio MCP 桥。为兼容旧版升级，保留但默认停用 `infinite-canvas-mcp` 行；如果旧配置覆盖层显式启用了该行，请将其停用。网页端 Agent 不需要这条 Harness MCP 配置。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 智能体工具：| 工具 | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| `infinite_canvas_status` | 独立检查后端连接和可选启动器状态 |
| `infinite_canvas_projects` | `list`、`create`、`rename`、`delete`；`open` 仅返回普通查看链接 |
| `infinite_canvas_nodes` | `summary`、`query`、`get`、`upstream`、`downstream`、`connected`；`create_text`、`create_primary_script`、`create_media`、`update_text`、`rename`、`move`、`delete`、`connect`、`disconnect`、`group`、`arrange` |
| `infinite_canvas_catalog` | 查询公开模型/渠道、已保存工作流、个人/系统技能和系统技能文件 |
| `infinite_canvas_media` | `submit`、只读 `status`、将结果回填节点的 `sync`、停止后端任务的 `stop` |

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 智能体工具：节点和媒体调用都需明确指定 `canvasId`。读取返回 `project.revision`；编辑节点、重命名/删除画布、提交/回填媒体任务时，需提供最新的 `expectedRevision`。写入保留项目中无关字段，并回读确认结果。同一插件内的写操作按画布串行执行，已知过期版本会被拒绝。**当前后端没有原子版本比较更新接口**，因此网页与 API 同时编辑仍可能竞争，不能将这些检查视为实时协同同步。

删除节点会清理画布连线、分组/批次成员关系和聊天中失效的媒体引用，但保留实际文件、后端任务及生成历史。不支持嵌套分组或对批次节点分组；单独移动批次节点及批次布局仍由网页完成。鼠标选区、网页未保存状态、本地 Codex 会话和浏览器私有模型配置不属于这套 API 的能力。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 后端媒体任务：先用 `create_media` 准备图片、视频或音频节点，该操作不会开始生成。`submit` 需明确提供后端 `channelId`，以及包含 `model` 和模型所需参数的 `request` JSON 对象，不能将 Key 放入该对象。支持 JSON 的图片编辑请求可使用 `edit: true`，并明确提供参考素材。

`status` 只读取任务；`sync` 将当前任务状态、主要结果地址和媒体元数据写入节点。额外结果地址保留在任务响应中，不复刻网页批次结果界面。工具可发现工作流，但暂不实现工作流执行、multipart 上传、浏览器本地渠道或任意模型专用参数转译。

生成需要用户授权，并可能消耗算力点。提交请求前会保存任务 ID，已提交节点不能再次提交。超时导致提交结果不确定时，应先按保留的任务 ID 查询，不要重发。停止任务不等于删除，也不保证退款。即使画布可编辑，仍需满足对应权限、模型请求格式和渠道可用性。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 凭证与本地文件：- 界面设置：`$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/settings.json`。
- API Key：`$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/canvas-api.json`，权限 `0600`，绑定已验证的站点地址；`CANVAS_API_KEY` 可覆盖插件行配置中站点对应的 Key。
- 可选网页 Agent 令牌：`~/.infinite-canvas/codex-agent.json`；启动器脱敏日志：`$DSH_HOME/infinite-canvas/agent.log`。

Key 仅通过 `Authorization` 请求头发送，不放入链接或模型工具输出。远程站点必须使用 HTTPS，本机测试允许 HTTP。带认证的请求不跟随重定向。更换站点后，旧 Key 不再可用，需为新地址重新验证 Key。

dsh-infinite-canvas README · 验证：```bash
node test/canvas.test.mjs
node test/host.test.mjs
node test/client.test.mjs
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts

测试覆盖图结构编辑与数据保留、版本冲突、分组移动、模拟媒体任务的提交/恢复/回填、HTTP 凭证隔离、本地 Agent 停止时的后端编辑、可选 Agent 启停，以及无自动浏览器导航的设置页渲染。真实收费生成需要针对所选模型和渠道另行授权验收。
